title: Writing a word by advancing
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, let $i$ be one of the $k$ work tapes, let $w_0$ be a finite word, and let $d$ be a configuration on an arbitrary fixed input whose state is the initial state $0$. After $|w_0|+1$ steps, the machine that writes $w_0$ while advancing on tape $i$ is in state $0$; on tape $i$, it has written $w_0$ starting at its initial head position and has advanced the head by $|w_0|$, while all other cells and tapes retain their previous contents. At every intermediate time $t$ with $0<t<|w_0|+1$, its state is not $0$. For every time $t\le |w_0|+1$, the head on tape $i$ lies between its initial position and that position plus $|w_0|$, inclusive, and every other tape head remains at its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $k$ work tapes
$d$ is a configuration on a fixed input
